note: Literature confirms a wide spectrum in FDXR deficiency from isolated optic-acoustic neuropathy to severe infantile Leigh syndrome with microcephaly and elevated CSF/plasma lactate.

evidence.text: Patients with FDXR deficiency present with a broad phenotypic spectrum ranging from Leigh syndrome with early demise and severe infantile-onset encephalopathy, microcephaly, and elevated CSF lactate, to milder movement disorders and optic atrophy/acoustic neuropathy.

source.title: Expanding the clinical and genetic spectrum of FDXR deficiency by functional validation of variants of uncertain significance
source.quote: Physical examination revealed microcephaly, slight facial … CSF lactate, in addition to features frequent to FDXR

evidence.text: FDXR mutations were initially reported in individuals presenting primarily with auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy without prominent early infantile Leigh-like encephalopathy.

source.title: FDXR mutations cause sensorial neuropathies and expand the spectrum of mitochondrial Fe-S-synthesis diseases
source.quote: Here, we report on eight subjects from four independent families affected by auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy.
